page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top, printed page number at top right. No marginal notes. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: seruetur nauis, Aliud est quæɾere quod perdideris; aliud est possidere quod nunquam amiseris.
Non simpliciter dicit, Ignoremus pœ-nitentiam: sed secundum quid, Ne facilè peccemus. Nam bis peccat, qui facilè peccat: quia pœnitentia facilè elui peccatum opinatur.

Addit, pœnitentiam esse quasi secun-dam tabulam post naufragium: quod si ita accipias, ut cum Augustino donū pœ-nitentiæ à Deo dari & compleri statuas: & ut, contrà quàm Novatiani olim statue-bant, lapsis post baptismum resipiscendū testeris, nihil incommodi habebit sententia Hieronymi.
Illud tamē in fine apparet, ad speciem, videlicet[?] ad virginitatem, quæ semel a-missa, pœnitentia recuperari nequit, re-spexisse.
main_text.head: VERSVS III,
main_text.p: Surrexit uero Ionah, ut fugeret in Thar-sis à facie Iehoua, & descendit Iapho: reperit autem nauim euntem in Tharsis, de-ditq; naulum, & descendit in eam, ut iret cum eis in Tharsis, à conspectu Iehoua.

page.notes: The line-end hyphens in "pœ-", "secun-", "statue-", "a-", "re-", "Thar-" and "de-" are printed and kept. "peccat" at the line end ("pec-" / "cat") shows no clear hyphen; I wrote it whole. "appaꝛet" and "ꝓidelicet" are doubtful forms; I read them as "apparet" and "videlicet". The ligature in "ditq;" is read from a small, worn glyph. The signature "§ 5" and the catchword "Gra" are partly cut off at the foot.
